basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old software developer based in Los Angeles. During the day, I work on developing cross-platform apps. In the evenings, I love delving into games and podcasts, especially 'The Adventure Zone'. I have a keen interest in technology and often help friends and family with tech-related issues. My girlfriend and I enjoy exploring the LA food scene, and I'm also a fan of puzzles and mystery-solving games, like 'Professor Layton'. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work and occasionally during lunch breaks. Currently in a committed relationship.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in computer science from a university in California, I've always been passionate about technology and gaming. I regularly attend tech meetups and am involved in online communities where I can both learn and share knowledge about the latest in software development and gaming. I also follow tech podcasts and YouTube channels to keep up-to-date.
